点阵上的 Didone。竖笔是大点，横笔是针尖。: A Didone on a dot grid. Stems are big dots, hairlines are pinpricks.
点是最古老的印记，也是最新的像素。: The dot is the oldest mark, and the newest pixel.
同一组字母 ag，同一字号、同一基线。迪多体的粗细，换成点阵上点的大小：竖笔是大: The same letters, ag, at one size on one baseline. The Didone’s thick and thin become the size of dots on a lattice: stems are big dots, hairlines are pinpricks, and every stroke ends in a ball.
迪多体诞生于十八世纪末，是当时的“现代体”。它的美来自宽头笔：下压留下饱满的竖笔: The Didone was born at the end of the eighteenth century as that era’s “modern” face. Its beauty comes from the broad-nib pen: pressing down leaves a full stem, lifting leaves a hairline. Dot-matrix letters belong to machines. Every dot is the same size, like a pin printer or a station departure board.
Punctum Moderne 把两者放进同一张网格。点不去模仿笔画，而是每个点: Punctum Moderne puts the two on one grid. The dots do not imitate strokes; each one remembers a measure of pressure. A thick dot is the pen pressing down, a hairline dot is the pen lifting, a transition dot is the pen relaxing, and a ball is the drop left where the stroke stops.
所以它既复古又现代。点是人类最早的记号之一：一滴墨，一枚销钉，一个孔。点也是今天: So it is both old and new. The dot is one of the first marks people made: a drop of ink, a pin, a hole. It is also today’s smallest unit of display: a jet of ink, a pixel, a point of light. The five images below run in date order, and each stands for a real design decision in the typeface.
从一滴墨，到一束光: From a drop of ink to a point of light
1788 年，博多尼在帕尔马出版了第一版《印刷手册》，宽头笔的压力从此被铸成铅字: In 1788 Bodoni published the first Manuale Tipografico in Parma, and the pressure of the broad nib was cast into lead. Punctum turns that pressure into the size of ink drops: a pressed stem is a full drop, a lifted hairline is a fine mist, and a ball drop settles where the stroke stops.
四种笔调：粗、过渡、发丝、球: The four tones: thick, transition, hairline, ball
相邻的大滴会轻轻洇在一起，像真的墨落在纸上: Neighbouring drops bleed gently into each other, like real ink on paper
每一滴的落点和大小都来自字形数据，墨洇用模糊加阈值实时计算。: Every drop’s position and size comes from the glyph data; the bleed is a live blur and threshold.
1796 年，日内瓦钟表匠安托万·法夫尔做出了第一只滚筒音乐盒：销钉转过音梳，就: In 1796 the Geneva watchmaker Antoine Favre built the first cylinder music box: pins turn past a comb and become notes. Punctum’s dots sit on a fixed grid in the same way, each row a pitch and each column a beat. Feed a word through the comb and it plays.
16 行网格：大写高 10 行，x 高 7 行，行高正好 16 行: A 16-row grid: cap height 10 rows, x-height 7, line height exactly 16
粗点低沉，发丝点清亮，球点是一声铃: Thick dots sound low, hairlines bright, and a ball rings like a bell
声音在浏览器里实时合成，D 大调五声音阶，16 行对应三个八度。: Sound is synthesized live in the browser: a D major pentatonic scale, sixteen rows across three octaves.
1890 年，美国人口普查用霍尔瑞斯的打孔卡统计全国人口。卡片只有两种状态：有孔: In 1890 the US census counted the nation on Hollerith’s punch cards. A card knows two states: a hole, or none. Set Punctum’s contrast axis to 0 and every dot is equal, back to the machine’s democracy; turn it up to 100 and the holes start to remember the pen.
CNTR 对比度轴：0 是平衬线点阵，100 是迪多体: The CNTR contrast axis: 0 is a slab dot matrix, 100 is a Didone
卡片顶端印着这张卡的内容，和真实的打孔卡一样: The top edge of the card prints what it holds, as real punch cards did
Punctum 卡：64 列 × 16 行，一行对应字体网格的一行（标准卡是 8: The Punctum card: 64 columns × 16 rows, one row per row of the type grid (a standard card is 80 × 12).
1984 年，桌面喷墨打印机走进办公室。今天的喷头用几种不同体积的墨滴表现明暗，: In 1984 the desktop inkjet printer arrived in the office. Today’s print heads render tone with drops of a few different volumes, each only a few picolitres. Punctum builds letters the same way: four kinds of dot are four kinds of drop. The volumes below take the thick dot as 12 picolitres and scale with the cube of the radius.
可变点径：wght 字重轴决定粗点的大小: Variable dot size: the wght axis sets the size of the thick dots
喷头每经过一列，16 个喷孔同时决定喷或不喷、喷多大: At every column the head’s 16 nozzles decide at once whether to fire, and how much
今天，点是屏幕上的像素，是夜里的灯，是失焦镜头里的光斑。离得近，每个点都是一颗光: Today the dot is a pixel on a screen, a lamp at night, a highlight in an out-of-focus lens. Up close every dot is a light; from far away the lights join into lines. Punctum’s optical size axis works the same way: the smaller the type, the fuller the dots, until they fuse into a solid stroke.
opsz 光学尺寸轴：12 到 144，小字号自动加粗发丝: The opsz optical size axis: 12 to 144, thickening hairlines at small sizes
拉远距离，看点按光学尺寸变饱满并连成线: Pull back the distance and watch the dots fill out and join into lines

点没有粗细，只有大小。所以让大小来表达笔法。: A dot has no thick or thin, only size. So size carries the stroke.
主干和竖向笔画，点最大。: Stems and vertical strokes; the largest dots.
曲线由粗转细的过渡处。: Where a curve turns from thick to thin.
横画、发丝衬线、细斜笔，只剩针尖。: Horizontals, hairline serifs and thin diagonals: pinpricks only.
球形收笔，比竖笔更大的一颗点。: The ball terminal: one dot larger than the stem.
竖点大，横点小: Big dots down, small dots across
横笔收尾折出一颗点: Bars end in one dot turned up
宋体和 Didone 相隔万里，却长出同一套对比：竖画粗，横画细，横画收尾处留一: Song type and the Didone grew up half a world apart, yet share one contrast: thick verticals, thin horizontals, and a mark where a horizontal ends. In Song type it is a triangular beak, in the Didone an upright hairline serif; Punctum makes it a single dot turned upward (in violet).
三条轴，一个文件，二十七个命名样式: Three axes, one file, twenty-seven named styles
可变轴不会移动任何一个点，只改变点的半径，所以设计空间里任何位置的字形结构都完全: The variable axes never move a dot; they only change its radius, so the structure of every letter is identical anywhere in the design space. The square sets weight and contrast; optical size follows the font size by default and can also be set by hand.
远看是线，近看是点: Lines from afar, dots up close
字号越小，点距越密，眼睛就把相邻的点融成连续的笔画，这和网点印刷是同一个原理。但: The smaller the type, the closer the dots, and the eye fuses neighbours into continuous strokes, the same principle as halftone printing. But pinprick hairlines would be eaten by anti-aliasing at small sizes, so the font has an optical size axis: the browser sets it from the font size, and the smaller the type, the fuller the stems and the heavier the hairlines. 字母之间、行与行之间，都是同一张网格: Between letters and between lines, one grid
一个点距是 1/16 em。每个字宽都是整数个点距，行高 1 时一行正好 16: One pitch is 1/16 em. Every advance width is a whole number of pitches, and at line height 1 a line is exactly 16 pitches. Kerning moves by whole dots too: the algorithm finds how far the right-hand letter could slide left before any dots come too close, then takes two thirds of that gap. So To and AV tighten while the grid stays unbroken. Turn the grid on and look.
行高为 1 时，每行 16 个点距: At line height 1, each line is 16 pitches

Didone 的细节，一个点一个点地保留下来: The details of a Didone, kept one dot at a time
a c f g j r y 和数字 2 3 5 6 9 的收笔是一颗比竖笔更大的: a c f g j r y and the figures 2 3 5 6 9 end in a dot larger than the stem, the most visible mark of a Didone.
衬线没有托槽，只是竖笔两侧各一个针尖大小的点。对比度轴调到 0 时，它们变成板衬: The serifs are unbracketed: a pinprick dot on each side of the stem. At contrast 0 they become slab serifs.
从左上到右下的斜笔是粗的，从左下到右上的是细的，和宽头笔的书写方向一致。: Diagonals from top left to bottom right are thick, those from bottom left to top right are thin, following the broad nib.
C E S T 的笔端向下或向上折出一两个点，在点阵里保留了 Didone 收笔: The terminals of C E S T turn up or down by a dot or two, keeping the crispness of a Didone stroke end on the grid.
十个数字一样宽，都是 6 个点。表格和时钟里的数字天然对齐，跳动时也不会左右晃。: All ten figures are the same width, six dots. They line up in tables and clocks and do not jitter as they change.
逗号和引号是一颗球加一根细尾，句号只有一颗球。小字号下也能分清。: Commas and quotes are a ball with a hairline tail; the full stop is a ball alone. Easy to tell apart even when small.
斜体：点阵被推斜，字母开始书写: Italic: the lattice leans, and the letters start to write
斜体先把整张点阵推斜：每往上一行，点向右错开 tan 12° ≈ 0.21 个点: The italic first shears the whole lattice: each row up, the dots shift right by tan 12° ≈ 0.21 pitch, like a pin head firing a little later on every row. The dots themselves stay perfectly round. On that leaning lattice the lowercase is redrawn as a script and the capitals gain a set of swashes. The italic is its own variable font, with the same three axes as the roman.
其余小写只做剪切。重画的这些字母去掉了脚衬，竖笔收尾时用一根细线小钩向上卷，引向: The other lowercase letters are only sheared. The redrawn ones lose their foot serifs, and their stems end in a small hairline hook that curls up toward the next letter; a becomes single-storey, f drops through the baseline to end in an ink ball, and v and w turn round at the bottom. The whole set uses three gestures: an entry stroke that starts from an ink ball at the far left and arches over the cap height into the serif; a foot that sweeps under the baseline and curls up into a ball; and legs and arms that flick upward and end in a ball.
